description: This file contains utility functions and mixins used for evaluating source code, color manipulations, map operations, and CSS-related string manipulations within a SASS/SCSS project, specifically tailored for Bootstrap styling.

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Mixin to verify that a Sass map with numeric values is in ascending order, issuing warnings if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Mixin to ensure that the first breakpoint in a map starts at zero, issuing a warning if it does not.

methods.name: to-rgb
methods.description: Function to convert a color value to its RGB components.

methods.name: rgba-css-var
methods.description: Function to generate RGBA CSS variable strings based on identifiers and targets, with Bootstrap-specific variable naming.

methods.name: map-loop
methods.description: Function to iterate over a map and apply a function to each key-value pair, returning a new map.

methods.name: varify
methods.description: Function that transforms a list of variable names into a space-separated string of CSS variables with a specific prefix.

methods.name: negativify-map
methods.description: Function to generate a map with keys prefixed with 'n' and values negated, used for Bootstrap's negative variants.

methods.name: map-get-multiple
methods.description: Function to retrieve multiple key-value pairs from a map based on a list of keys.

methods.name: map-merge-multiple
methods.description: Function to merge multiple maps into one.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Recursive string replacement function, used for processing SVG data URIs.

methods.name: escape-svg
methods.description: Function to escape SVG strings for embedding in CSS, encoding special characters.

methods.name: color-contrast
methods.description: Function to select an appropriate contrasting color against a background, based on a minimum contrast ratio.

methods.name: contrast-ratio
methods.description: Calculates the contrast ratio between two colors based on WCAG guidelines.

methods.name: luminance
methods.description: Computes the relative luminance of a color for contrast calculations.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Generates an opaque version of a color by blending with a background.

methods.name: tint-color
methods.description: Tints a color by mixing it with white.

methods.name: shade-color
methods.description: Shades a color by mixing it with black.

methods.name: shift-color
methods.description: Shades or tints a color depending on the weight's sign.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two values with optional calc string output.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts two values with optional calc string output.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides two numbers with support for units and custom precision.
